fullPassage: In the middle of a major disaster, community mapping can prove to be a very effective and important tool. The first responders to a disaster are often ordinary citizens. They can use maps to create and update data on health facilities, shelters, or even public roads. When community members work together at the time of a disaster, the (A) [gathering / gathered] information can be based on actual needs rather than guesses. This is particularly (B) [critical / critically] when every second counts. For example, community mapping helped (C) [deal / to deal] with the impact of Hurricane Sandy, one of the most destructive hurricanes to hit the United States.

questions.passage: Everyone has unique experiences, but many people remain <u>ⓐ isolated</u> and disconnected from what goes on outside their lives. Community mapping helps people look outside of themselves, connect with other members of their communities, and <u>ⓑ share</u> valuable experiences. Community mapping is a collective process. It enables members of a community <u>ⓒ to map</u> details of the places <u>ⓓ which</u> they live and other places they know about. Community mapping is also a unique and valuable tool as it can <u>ⓔ be used</u> in diverse ways.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

det.korean: 그들이 살고 있는 장소들의 세부 사항을 지도에 표시할 수 있게 해 준다. live는 자동사이므로 뒤에 전치사가 필요합니다. 선행사 the places는 장소이므로 관계부사 where(= in which)를 써야 합니다. 관계대명사 which를 쓰려면 in which로 전치사를 동반해야 합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: the places which they live → the places where they live
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: In the middle of a major disaster, community mapping can prove to be a very effective and important tool. The first responders to a disaster are often ordinary citizens. They can use maps to create and update data on health facilities, shelters, or even public roads. When community members work together at the time of a disaster, the (A) [gathering / gathered] information can be based on actual needs rather than guesses. This is particularly (B) [critical / critically] when every second counts. For example, community mapping helped (C) [deal / to deal] with the impact of Hurricane Sandy, one of the most destructive hurricanes to hit the United States.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현을 골라 바르게 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 재난 시 지역 주민들이 함께 일하면, 수집된 정보는 추측이 아닌 실제 필요에 기반할 수 있다. 이것은 매초가 중요할 때 특히 결정적이다. 예를 들어, 커뮤니티 매핑은 허리케인 Sandy의 영향에 대처하는 데 도움이 되었다.
det.analysis: 원문: the gathered information / particularly critical / helped deal with
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: One of its main effects was energy failures. Residents in affected areas would wait for hours in line at gas stations, sometimes only <u>ⓐ to learn</u> that they were out of gasoline. In response to this problem, a group of high school students in New Jersey worked together to create an online community map, <u>ⓑ publishing</u> information on open gas stations with available fuel. The students gathered information from personal observations, calls to local gas stations, and updates from other social media users. The live data streams <u>ⓒ filling</u> a significant community information gap.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

det.korean: 실시간 데이터 스트림은 상당한 지역 사회 정보 공백을 메워 주었다. 이 문장의 주어 The live data streams에 대한 본동사가 필요합니다. filling(현재분사)은 동사 역할을 할 수 없으므로, 과거시제 동사 filled로 고쳐야 합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: The live data streams filling a significant community information gap. → filled
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: Mapping can also rally community members around the (A) [assets / deficits] of their community such as libraries, community centers, and parks. Heritage and cultural attractions, like landmarks, museums, and public artworks, are also good sources for community mapping. Through marking assets on a map, people become (B) [aware / ignorant] of the strengths and resources of their own community and build a strong bond with it. Also, these maps can (C) [provide / deprive] valuable data to be used for tourism or urban design.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 매핑은 또한 도서관, 커뮤니티 센터, 공원과 같은 지역 사회의 자산 주위로 구성원들을 결집시킬 수 있다. 지도에 자산을 표시함으로써, 사람들은 자신의 지역 사회의 강점과 자원을 인식하게 되고 유대감을 형성한다. 또한, 이 지도들은 관광이나 도시 설계에 사용될 귀중한 자료를 제공할 수 있다.
det.analysis: 원문: rally community members around the assets / become aware of the strengths / can provide valuable data
det.tip: 어휘 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: The mapping project Where in Wally (short for Walthamstow, UK) is a case in point. A team of architects ① <u>undertook</u> the project to find out what spots were loved by the locals. People told the team about their ② <u>treasured</u> places and the reasons why these places were special to them. The team then added the places to an online map and marked them in the real world with yellow tags. The map and tags ③ <u>discouraged</u> people to go on a treasure hunt and told them colorful stories about the corners of Walthamstow.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 그 지도와 태그는 사람들이 보물찾기를 하도록 초대했고(invited) Walthamstow 곳곳에 대한 다채로운 이야기를 들려주었다. 문맥상 지도와 태그가 사람들을 보물찾기로 '이끌었다/초대했다'는 긍정적 의미여야 하므로, discouraged(단념시켰다)는 반대 의미로 부적절합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: The map and tags discouraged people to go on a treasure hunt → invited
det.tip: 어휘 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: A community mapping project doesn't have to be ① <u>ambitious</u> in scale. If the idea of mapping ② <u>overwhelms</u> you, start small. Although it may seem that you know all about the routes to school, students have ③ <u>identical</u> information from one another due to different experiences. How about making a map with your classmates? Each of you can trace routes that you frequently use and mark how ④ <u>comfortable</u> or safe you feel on those routes. With group participation and feedback, an ⑤ <u>informative</u> visual map of safe routes to school can be constructed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 학생들은 서로 다른 경험 때문에 서로 다른(different) 정보를 가지고 있다. 원문에서 'due to different experiences(다른 경험 때문에)'라고 했으므로 정보도 '다르다'가 자연스럽습니다. identical(동일한)은 문맥과 반대입니다.
det.analysis: 원문: students have identical information → different
det.tip: 어휘 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: Everyone has unique experiences, but many people remain isolated and disconnected from what goes on outside their lives. Community mapping helps people look outside of themselves, connect with other members of their communities, and share valuable experiences. Community mapping is a collective process. It enables members of a community to map details of the places where they live and other places they know about. Community mapping is also a unique and valuable tool as it can be used in diverse ways.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 커뮤니티 매핑은 사람들이 자기 자신 너머를 바라보고, 지역 사회의 다른 구성원들과 연결되며, 가치 있는 경험을 공유하도록 돕는다. 이 글은 커뮤니티 매핑이 무엇이며(정의), 집단 과정으로서 다양한 방식으로 사용될 수 있는 가치 있는 도구임(가치)을 설명하고 있다.
det.analysis: 원문: Community mapping helps people look outside of themselves, connect with other members of their communities, and share valuable experiences.
det.tip: 대의 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

the definition and value of community mapping as a collective tool
the technological challenges of creating online maps
the history of mapping techniques in ancient civilizations

questions.passage: The researchers participating in the Montreal Tree Project asked residents and public institutions around Concordia University for help. The researchers asked them to photograph the bark and leaves of the trees on their properties and submit the photos to the project's website for analysis. The project is now complete, and they say the results show the importance of having a diverse tree population in a city. Trees on private lands were found to be more diverse than those on public lands.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 결과는 도시에 다양한 나무 개체군을 갖는 것의 중요성을 보여준다. 이 글은 Montreal Tree Project를 통해 도시 내 나무 다양성의 중요성을 연구한 내용이다.
det.analysis: 원문: the results show the importance of having a diverse tree population in a city.
det.tip: 대의 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

ch: How to Grow Trees in Urban Areas
The Role of Tree Diversity in Urban Ecosystems
Why Public Parks Need More Trees

questions.passage: There isn't just one reason for, nor one method of, carrying out community mapping. The process is defined by the community itself, depending on what issues are raised and how the community members decide to deal with them. The most important thing in the process is that you have to work with others. Remember that, by its very nature, community mapping is a collective experience.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 필자가 전달하고자 하는 시사점으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그 과정에서 가장 중요한 것은 다른 사람들과 함께 일해야 한다는 것이다. 커뮤니티 매핑은 본질적으로 집단적 경험이다. 필자는 커뮤니티 매핑이 참여자들에 의해 형성되는 근본적으로 협력적인 과정임을 강조하고 있다.
det.analysis: 원문: The most important thing in the process is that you have to work with others. Community mapping is a collective experience.
det.tip: 대의 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

ch: Community mapping should be led by professional cartographers.
The success of community mapping depends on individual effort.
Community mapping is fundamentally a collaborative process shaped by its participants.
Government agencies should fund all community mapping projects.

det.analysis: 원문: a group of high school students in New Jersey worked together to create an online community map, publishing information on open gas stations with available fuel.

Community mapping is a c__________ process that helps people connect with their communities and share experiences.

det.korean: 커뮤니티 매핑은 집단적인 과정이다. 빈칸에는 c로 시작하는 단어 collective(집단적인)가 들어간다.
det.analysis: 원문: Community mapping is a collective process.
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: Through marking assets on a map, people become aware of the strengths and resources of their own community and build a strong bond with it. Also, these maps can provide valuable data to be used for tourism or urban design.
questions.stem:
다음 조건을 참고하여, 주어진 단어를 모두 사용해 빈칸에 들어갈 영어 문장을 완성하시오.

[조건]
• 주어진 단어를 모두 사용하되, 필요시 어형을 변환하시오.
• 7단어 이상으로 작성하시오.

[보기] provide / map / the / can / data / valuable

[문장]
Also, these ____________________________________________ for tourism or urban design.

det.korean: 또한, 이 지도들은 관광이나 도시 설계에 사용될 귀중한 자료를 제공할 수 있다. 주어진 단어(provide, map, the, can, data, valuable)를 활용하여 원문과 같은 의미의 문장을 완성한다.
det.analysis: 원문: Also, these maps can provide valuable data to be used for tourism or urban design.
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: Community mapping is a collective process. It enables members of a community to map details of the places where they live and other places they know about. Community mapping is also a unique and valuable tool as it can be (use) in diverse ways.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.

Community mapping is also a unique and valuable tool as it can be (use) in diverse ways.

det.korean: 그것은 다양한 방식으로 사용될 수 있다. 조동사 can + be + 과거분사(p.p.)로 수동태를 만든다. use → used
det.analysis: 원문: it can be used in diverse ways
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.
